branch_interpretation: At eval, dropout is identity and head linear: M1 margin=(w1-w0)h_base+(b1-b0)+(w1-w0)h_residual. Infer common-path margin by subtracting actual residual contribution from saved log probability ratio. This is frozen-model algebra, not a trained ablation, not independent feature importance, and not proof of physical causation. Shared backbone/head also changed during separate fine-tuning.
limitations: One seed, exposed source-Val, overlapping windows and paired SIL/HIL not independent.
Directory flight status is recorded scenario, crop30s is descriptive not certified phase.
Train-normal percentiles compare residuals within recorded domain/mode; not probability of health, and not motion/strength-matched experimental controls.
Time-asynchronous publication consistency is not physical health truth.
No per-axis causal attribution or claims that residual features caused learned backbone changes.
